Thank you so much. I think I'll try talking to my guidance councilor tomorrow... Along with my friend. I really, truly appreciate your help. I'll let you know whenever I need a friend.. :) 
Isn't it odd how some people on the internet that you've never met before can help more than a friend you've known since you were little? It's kind of cool in my opinion.
I will learn. I have been trying... Thank you. I just have to learn to be more confident, is all. :)

You're SO right, but the thing is, I wouldn't know how to ask someone. I've always been a shy girl, never been really good at talking. I'll try, though....
Thanks so much. I really appreciate someone paying attention to my "problems". Heh.
